title: Return the stock left
prompt: Repair `stockAfter`. It must return `opening` plus `delivered` minus `sold`: the items on a shelf at the end of the day. Inputs are nonnegative counts, and sales never exceed the items available. The starter tries to return a name outside its block.
hints: Read the name mentioned in the diagnostic.
Find the pair of braces that contains the declaration of that name.
Return a value from a place where all of its inputs are in scope.
feedback: Read the name mentioned in the diagnostic.
